Done. Migrated the 12 leftover files, 36 call sites, from `db.query` to `db.execute({ sql, params })`.

Left `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` alone, since that's vendored code. Also left `cache.query` calls alone, they're a different thing.

The repo's own check script confirms it: `OK every db.query call site moved to db.execute, and nothing else moved`.
